question: Which club won the 2025 UEFA Champions League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris Saint-Germain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paris Saint-Germain (PSG)** clinched their first-ever **UEFA Champions League** title in the **2024-25** season, marking a historic achievement for the **French** club.
 
• The final was held at the **Allianz Arena** in **Munich**, **Germany**, on **May 31, 2025**, which saw a capacity crowd witness the crowning of a new European champion.
 
• **PSG** defeated **Manchester City** in the final with a scoreline of **2-1**, with decisive goals coming from their star-studded lineup.
 
• This victory was the culmination of a decade-long project by the club's ownership, **Qatar Sports Investments**, who acquired the club in **2011** with the primary goal of winning this prestigious trophy.
 
• By winning the title, **Paris Saint-Germain** became only the second **French** club in history to win the competition, joining **Olympique de Marseille** who won it in **1993**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UEFA Champions League Format Change:**
 
 
• The **2024-25** season was the first to implement the new **"Swiss Model"** or **League Phase**, expanding the competition from **32** to **36** teams.
 
• Instead of traditional groups, each team played **eight** matches against different opponents to determine their ranking in a single league table.
 
 
 
• **Venue Details:**
 
 
• The **Allianz Arena**, the home of **Bayern Munich**, hosted the final for the first time since the **2012** season.
 
• With a capacity of approximately **75,000**, it remains one of the most modern and iconic football stadiums in **Europe**.
 
 
 
• **Tournament Statistics:**
 
 
• **Kylian Mbappé**, playing for **PSG**, finished as one of the top scorers of the tournament, contributing significantly to the club's success in the knockout stages.
 
• The tournament featured a total of **189** matches under the expanded format, compared to the **125** matches in previous seasons.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Managerial Success:** **Luis Enrique**, the manager of **Paris Saint-Germain**, became one of the elite coaches to have won the **Champions League** with two different clubs, having previously won it with **FC Barcelona** in **2015**.
 
• **Qualification:** As winners of the **2025** final, **PSG** earned an automatic spot in the **2025-26 UEFA Champions League** league phase and a place in the **2025 UEFA Super Cup**.
 
• **Financial Impact:** The winner of the **2025** edition received a prize of **€20 million** for the final victory, part of a total prize pool exceeding **€2.4 billion** distributed among participating clubs.
 
• **Historical Context:** **Real Madrid** remains the most successful club in the history of the competition with **15** titles, but they were unable to defend their **2024** title after being eliminated in the earlier rounds of the **2024-25** campaign.
